title: Tunisian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by the cuisine of Tunisia, made with tender mung beans and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add sliced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add mung beans, mushrooms, and Tunisian spice blend. Cook for 1 minute.
Pour in bean broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in chopped green onions and lemon juice.
Cook sujuk noodles according to package instructions.
Serve stew over noodles and enjoy!
